calibration_contract.statement: Biological production parameters are estimated only from liquid-wine chemistry. Combined condensate never contributes to the objective function.

capture_contract.observation: All predicted gas loss is compared with the combined A+B MIX as an external closure diagnostic.

model_contract.assumed_complete_capture_equilibrium: Two sugar-linked formation yields fitted only to wine; fixed Morakul/Mouret partition; eta_AB=1.
model_contract.assumed_complete_capture_delayed_respons: Wine-only baseline plus a smooth nutrient-pulse response; fixed Morakul/Mouret partition; eta_AB=1.

validation_policy.selection_rule: Select the simplest wine-calibrated production model satisfying both-compound wine and independent-condensate thresholds, convergence, parameter-bound and mass-balance gates.

data_quality_policy.reason: Common six-analyte spike at 144 h; raw chromatogram and independent duplicate unavailable.

interpretation_limits.production: Wine-only calibration prevents condensate recovery assumptions from changing biological yields.
interpretation_limits.condensate: Condensate is a closure prediction under eta_AB=1, not a calibration target.
interpretation_limits.capture: Failure of condensate closure rejects the joint partition-plus-complete-capture contract but does not identify physical condenser efficiency.
interpretation_limits.pulse: Pulse timing and protocol temperature transitions remain partially confounded.
interpretation_limits.external_validation: Leave-one-run-out is retrospective internal validation; prospective confirmation remains required.
